$description: Font size scales. Steps are named xs, sm, base, lg, xl, 2xl, 3xl, 4xl (base = typography.baseSize). Modular scales multiply the base by a ratio per step and round to even pixels.

presets.label: Hand-tuned utility scale
presets.description: Fixed sizes picked by hand rather than by a ratio, each paired with its own line height. The default; ignores baseSize.

presets.label: Minor second (1.067)
presets.description: Very gentle growth; steps are hard to tell apart. Suits dense data screens with few levels.

presets.label: Major second (1.125)
presets.description: Small steps for product UI with many text levels.

presets.label: Major third (1.25)
presets.description: Clear hierarchy without very large headings.

presets.label: Perfect fourth (1.333)
presets.description: Strong contrast between levels; good for content and marketing pages. Small steps get small fast.

presets.label: Augmented fourth (1.414)
presets.description: Large jumps; few levels fit before headings get huge.

presets.label: Golden ratio (1.618)
presets.description: The largest common ratio; display-heavy pages only.
